profile.label: Who you are
profile.text: David "DJ" Wayne, about 36, lives in Glen Burnie, Maryland (Baltimore-Washington corridor). US citizen and Marine Corps veteran. Married with three young children; family time limits his availability.

profile.label: Military service
profile.text: US Marine Corps 2012-2017: infantry, then Scout Sniper Team Leader. Deployed to Afghanistan (2013) and Kuwait (2016). Graduated Marine Scout Sniper School; honor graduate of the Corporal/NCO leadership course. Held a Secret clearance through 2021 and is eligible for reinstatement with an employer sponsor. Eligible for veteran benefits such as a VA home loan and veteran-owned business certification.

profile.label: Engineering career
profile.text: About 9 years as a software engineer after a 2017 coding bootcamp. Federal contracting 2018-2021: the search interface for the US Census Bureau's data.census.gov; a knowledge-graph query builder for US Air Force intelligence analysts; migration of a Marine Corps military-justice case archive. Curri (Y Combinator S19 construction-materials delivery startup), Jan 2022-Feb 2025: rebuilt the real-time operations triage console used daily by about 20 service reps, and built and owned integrations with seven outside delivery networks (Uber, Lyft, DoorDash and others) so deliveries automatically failed over to them. Has not held a salaried job since leaving Curri in February 2025.

profile.label: Skills
profile.text: Senior full-stack engineer: TypeScript, React, Svelte, Node.js, PostgreSQL/Supabase. Hands-on with LLM systems: multi-model routing, tool calling, agent harnesses, MCP integrations, and evaluation harnesses. Strong at demos and briefings (briefed commanders as a sniper); an extroverted engineer who likes explaining what he built. No college degree (bootcamp certificate plus two years of community college).

profile.label: What you own today
profile.confirm: 9takes traffic comes from the resume and hasn't been re-checked. Paid client history is inferred.
profile.text: BuildOS (since spring 2025): an AI 'thinking environment' he built solo that turns messy notes and voice into projects, tasks and daily briefs. 124 total signups, 4 in the last 30 days, 0 paying customers; paid billing has not launched (planned price $20/month). 9takes.com: a long-running Enneagram personality discussion site with hundreds of articles and roughly 15,000 monthly unique visitors, not meaningfully monetized. Has built websites for a few small clients, including the booking site for a precision-rifle training company; paid client history is thin.

profile.label: Current plan
profile.text: Plan as of September 2026: sell 'AI operator' services to Maryland businesses under the BuildOS name. Lead niche: commercial specialty subcontractors with $5-30M revenue (electrical, mechanical, concrete). Offer ladder: a $3,500 two-week 'Bid Desk' audit of the estimating inbox, then $5,000-$25,000 build sprints, then $2,000-$8,000/month retainers. Has researched 48 named local prospects but has contacted none yet. Upcoming local events: business lunches on Sept 22 and 24, a construction-association gala on Oct 21, and the TEDCO Entrepreneur Expo in Baltimore on Oct 27. In parallel, interviewing for forward-deployed engineer roles at AI companies.

profile.label: Network
profile.text: Former Curri colleagues and founders in the Y Combinator network; the Marine scout-sniper community, including his former sniper instructor's training company and a well-known Marine-recon trainer he has met personally; a church community (he grew up a pastor's kid); a local circle of fathers. Active on LinkedIn but has no large public audience.

profile.label: Money situation
profile.text: Bootstrapping. Household money is tight; income since February 2025 has come from occasional freelance work. He cannot absorb large losses.

profile.label: How you actually work
profile.text: Relentless and persistent, with repeated comebacks from setbacks. Weaknesses named in his own reviews: he tends to over-engineer products, and he tends to prepare outreach (drafts, prospect lists, campaigns) without actually sending it. Prefers building to selling, but is a confident presenter once he is in the room.

Built around several specific advantages in the profile that few competitors share.
